logline: A Milwaukee pizza worker living in his big brother’s shadow meets a woman who awakens him to books, meditation, and selfhood—until family violence and a fatal crash force him to leave, rebuild, and finally forgive.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Dad leaves when narrator is about eight; lives with Ma and Nick in fifth-floor walk-up on Kirk Street, Milwaukee; Nick is feared protector and modern-day Viking figure.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: I lived with him and Ma after dad took off when I was about eight. We lived downtown in a big brick apartment building on Kirk Street.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Girl trips into narrator outside pizza place; name Sionna; coffee at Java Hut; Wuthering Heights; dreams of past-life forest/horse; yoga and Buddhism talk.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: this girl tripped over the cement while she was walking toward me... “Sionna” she said.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Ma confuses church/Mrs. Canasta; high blood pressure; ER; three-day hospital stay; pill organizer with Sionna’s help.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: Your mother’s blood pressure is dangerously high... take her directly to the emergency room

source_grounded_timeline.events: Missed doctor appointment fight; later Joe’s bar confrontation over Lindsey; Nick nearly hits narrator; narrator runs to Sionna.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: I could see Nick’s creased brow... his right fist slowly drawing back and moving toward my face.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Nick takes Ma to mass after drinking; broadside crash Werner and Lowe; Ma dies at scene; Nick serious injuries; possible vehicular manslaughter.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: your brother is in serious condition at Frodo and your mother passed away at the scene.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Nick blames Sionna; confronts her at duplex with switchblade; narrator walks in; knife hits her; Nick flees.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: The knife hits her hard and there is red flying out... I wipe the blade off on her shirt

source_grounded_timeline.events: Sionna survives but leaves; narrator builds Tony’s Boy’s Pizza chain in Seattle; dream of sage; visits Nick in Green Bay prison; forgives; name Peter Olson revealed.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: I own a pizza chain in Seattle... President Peter Olson.

withheld_name_rules.rule: Do not state or display full name until final prison/airport beat; use little brother / I / Bro until then.
withheld_name_rules.source_evidence: I whispered to myself, “That’s me. President Peter Olson.”

withheld_name_rules.rule: May use Ma until funeral/grave; full Olivia Anne Olsen only at marker.
withheld_name_rules.source_evidence: Mother: Olivia Anne Olsen. August 28, 1933 to September 7, 1998.

withheld_name_rules.rule: Hold emotional aftermath and separation until after hospital/ICU recovery beats; do not foreshadow Seattle life early.
withheld_name_rules.source_evidence: As long as there is any doubt, I can’t go on with you.

essential_beats.description: Establish Nick’s physical dominance and narrator’s subordinate care of Ma in Kirk Street walk-up.
essential_beats.source_evidence: Nick was the guy everybody was scared of... I lived with him and Ma

essential_beats.description: Sidewalk collision outside pizza place; Sionna; fish necklace; coffee invitation.
essential_beats.source_evidence: She fell and just kind of brushed into me with her shoulder... “if you want to go have a cup of coffee sometime, you can call me.”

essential_beats.description: Narrator gets library card, checks out Wuthering Heights; dreams mix Sionna/Catherine.
essential_beats.source_evidence: I just picked out “Wuthering Heights” by a lady named Emily Bronte.

essential_beats.description: Java Hut talk of symbols, love that destroys; narrator feels smarter; dinner date.
essential_beats.source_evidence: A love that never changes will destroy you. It reminded me of the way Nick is

essential_beats.description: Ma glassy-eyed confusion; later dangerously high BP; hospital; pill box.
essential_beats.source_evidence: I’m afraid of the risk of a stroke... admit her for observation

essential_beats.description: Joe’s: Nick confronts Lindsey’s date; narrator intervenes; fist toward face; flight to Sionna.
essential_beats.source_evidence: No one cares about your ego Nick!” I was yelling at him

essential_beats.description: Police messages; Ma dead at scene; Nick ICU; narrator’s rage at Nick.
essential_beats.source_evidence: your mother passed away at the scene... Die you fucking jackass.

essential_beats.description: Nick at Sionna’s duplex; knife to collarbone; narrator enters; blood; Nick flees.
essential_beats.source_evidence: I placed the edge of the knife in between her skinny collarbone and boob... The knife hits her hard

essential_beats.description: Sionna cannot continue; years later Seattle pizza owner; sage dream; decision to forgive.
essential_beats.source_evidence: I forgive you, Nick, because it also releases your control over me forever

essential_beats.description: Green Bay visit; names Nick asshole then forgives; Nick weeps; President Peter Olson.
essential_beats.source_evidence: I forgive you. I forgive you for being a huge asshole because it sets me free.

scene_outline.purpose: Open on Ma’s apartment, Nick’s presence, narrator’s duty.
scene_outline.source_evidence: We lived downtown in a big brick apartment building on Kirk Street. A fifth-floor walk-up
just as I was walking down the sidewalk and into the front door of the pizza place, this girl tripped
I walked real fast over there and saw they were open till 9 o’clock
We decided to meet downtown at a coffee shop called The Java Hut.

scene_outline.purpose: Ma confusion and later med crisis setup.
scene_outline.source_evidence: Did we go to church today? Did you see Mrs. Canasta there?
The music was turned up loud as we opened the door to Joe’s Bar and Grill.

scene_outline.purpose: Refuge after bar; later stabbing climax.
scene_outline.source_evidence: I found myself running to Sionna’s house

scene_outline.purpose: Crash news; Ma dead; Nick ICU.
scene_outline.source_evidence: they were hit broadside while going through the intersection of Werner and Lowe.

scene_outline.purpose: Years later; pizza chain; decision to return.
scene_outline.source_evidence: I now had my own chain of pizzerias here in the Northwest... Tony’s Boy’s Pizza.
Nick was being held in Green Bay at the correctional institute there
